points.description: States that strain is a ratio (a dimensionless quantity) comparing change to original, i.e. strain = change in length / original length.
points.partial_credit: Half if only 'ratio' or 'change in length' is stated without the other part, or the ratio is stated vaguely.

points.description: Identifies the correct quantities: change in length (deformation/elongation) divided by the original length.
points.partial_credit: Half if the denominator is wrong or missing (e.g. just 'change in length' or 'deformation per length' without saying original).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying strain is the ratio of change in length (deformation/extension) to original length; synonyms such as 'elongation per unit length' are fine. Give 1 mark if only part is right, e.g. 'change in length' with no ratio to original length, or 'deformation' described vaguely. Give 0 for wrong ideas such as force per area (that is stress) or unrelated answers.
